The dropped clause is NOT merely redundant with the type name: _keep raises FileExistsError from TWO places — line 216 (the deliberate create-only collision, final.exists()) and line 217 os.open(O_CREAT|O_EXCL) on the .tmp sibling a prior failed write left (measured: that raises `FileExistsError: [Errno 17] File exists: '.../name.tmp'`). The clause is the only thing that tells the operator the first (the never-overwrite invariant, INV-MUTATION-AUTHORITY) apart from the second. entries.grounds: mutant_view confirms L119 `except (ValueError, RecursionError):` -> `except (ValueError,):`. Matters only if json.loads(detail) raises RecursionError. Verified empirically on the measurement interpreter (python 3.14.7, C json scanner): json.loads('['*N+']'*N) returns a list with no RecursionError for N up to 100000, and deep dicts to 20000 — the C scanner does not raise RecursionError for any practical input, and detail is always a string, so the guard is unreachable here.
